about_the_game:
Supernatural Visual Novel "The Fourteenth Ξ (Guzai) Vol. 1 & 2"

This is the final chapter following the supernatural visual novels "Omega no Shikai" and "Aru Fa no Oto Me."

On a certain moonlit night, a bloodstained monster descends before a girl.

Those who participate in a mysterious "game" to fulfill their desires.

The winner of this "game" is only one—

A supernatural visual novel for cats, "The Fourteenth Ξ (Guzai)."

◆Synopsis◆

Middle school girls in their second year, preparing for final exams.

An urban legend of a "telephone pole that should not exist" is sighted.

A "game" where the last remaining winner's wish is granted.

The "Eight Sisters," the silver assassin, and the mysterious "RULERS."

A supernatural suspense story full of survival and conspiracy.

This work is currently ongoing, and the story will continue to unfold.

◆Features◆

- Unique supernatural world and intricate scenario

- The long-awaited final chapter of the series (ongoing)

- Hand-drawn illustrations and heavy atmospheric presentation

- PC compatible (Windows 10 / 11)

Illustration and scenario are created solely by Kannuki Yoake (writer name: Amamura Kekka),

who has been working alone on this project for over 15 years.

This work is filled with deep dedication to detailed worldbuilding and storytelling.

Note: The scenario text is available only in Japanese.

content_descriptors.notes:
This title contains mature content. 
It depicts scenes of violence, blood, and supernatural horror elements. 
There are no depictions of sexual acts or sexual assault. 
Players who may be sensitive to violence or disturbing imagery should be advised.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
